calls.text: My Northstar is out of warranty. What does it cost just to have the bench look at it?

calls.system:
You answer questions for the staff of Lantern Supply Co. from the
passages provided, and from nothing else. Cite every fact with the number of the passage it
comes from, like [2]. If passages disagree, prefer the one from the more recent document.
When the passages do not answer the question, reply exactly: I don't know.
Be brief: a sentence or two.
calls.prompt:
Passages:

[1] repair-manual.pdf p.1
Each ticket gets a coloured tag tied to the bail or handle:
Red tag: warranty repair. The claim already has a WC- number from Customer Service.
No charge to the customer, and the return shipping is on us.
Yellow tag: paid repair. The customer has agreed to the bench fee and to an estimate
for parts.
Green tag: Second Light refurbishment. These are returns and trade-ins being rebuilt
for the refurbished shelf. There is no customer waiting, so they are worked after red
and yellow tags.
The bench fee for a paid repair is $25.00 plus parts at the catalogue price of the part. The fee
is waived under warranty. If a yellow-tag repair turns out to need parts beyond the estimate
by more than $10, stop and have Customer Service call the customer before you continue. Do
not guess at what the customer would want.

[2] repair-manual.pdf p.3
The Northstar is our most repaired product by a wide margin, which is a function of how
many we sell and of how it is used, not of any weakness. Nearly every Northstar fault is one
of four things: a clogged generator, a dry pump cup, a torn mantle, or the wrong fuel. Ask
about the fuel first. The Northstar burns Clearburn white gas or unleaded gasoline. It does
not burn kerosene, and a tank that has had kerosene in it will have a varnished generator
and a sticky check valve. That is a paid repair even inside the warranty period.
Tools for the Northstar bench: 11 mm and 13 mm open-ended wrenches, the generator
wrench (part T-ND2, the thin 9 mm one with the bent handle), a small flat screwdriver, the
pump cup oil bottle, a nylon brush, and the torque driver set to 2.5 N·m for checking.
Generator tube replacement
The generator (part G-GEN2) is the tube that runs up through the burner and carries fuel
from the tank to the mantles. Signs of a bad generator are a weak yellow flame that will not
steady, pulsing light, and a tank that holds pressure but will not deliver it. The part is
$13.00, so a typical generator replacement on a yellow tag comes to $38.00 with the bench
fee.

[3] warranty.md > Out of warranty
## Out of warranty

Products outside their warranty period, and declined claims, can be repaired by the Repair Center
for a fee. The customer is quoted before any work is done and can decline the quote, in which
case the product is returned at the customer's shipping cost. The Repair Center's own manual
describes the fee schedule and the shop procedures.

Question: My Northstar is out of warranty. What does it cost just to have the bench look at it?
calls.reply: I don't know. The passages give the $25.00 bench fee for a paid repair, plus parts [1], and say the customer is quoted before any work and can decline [3], but they don't say whether there is a separate charge just to inspect or diagnose a product.
